_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Provenance profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifProvenance/cdifProvenanceSchema.json with the value class at metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/cdifDataType/cdifProvActivity/cdifProvActivitySchema.json. The Provenance profile module defines prov:wasGeneratedBy as an array of ProvActivity items describing how the dataset was generated. ProvActivity is a richly attributed activity class: prov:used (with optional schema:instrument sub-key for instruments), schema:agent / schema:participant (Person/Organization/AgentInRole), schema:object (input entities, supports action chaining via @id back-references), schema:result, schema:actionStatus / startTime / endTime / location / actionProcess / error / additionalProperty. Conforms-to identifier: https://w3id.org/cdif/provenance/1.0. Person/Organization/AgentInRole/Identifier are referenced from CDIFCore (cross-profile registry); Instrument is restated here as a local class. The DDI-CDI source provenance is Activity in the v1.1beta XMI (sourceClass=Activity preserves that provenance link).

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Provenance Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Provenance activities describing how a dataset was generated: agents, instruments, temporal bounds, methodology, action chaining
targetModel.definition: CDIF Provenance profile module - documents prov:wasGeneratedBy on a Dataset as a sequence of ProvActivity items. Each ProvActivity extends the minimal prov:Activity with schema.org Action vocabulary (instruments, agents, temporal bounds, action chaining via schema:object back-references to earlier activities' schema:result). Conforms-to identifier: https://w3id.org/cdif/provenance/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Provenance activities, instruments, and action chaining for CDIF metadata records.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Provenance classes: ProvActivity (the activity) and Instrument (used by activities).

class._comment: ProvActivity - the activity that generated the described resource. Dual-typed @type must include both prov:Activity (PROV) and schema:Action (schema.org Action vocabulary for instruments/agents/temporal/chaining). DDI-CDI sourceClass=Activity preserves the provenance Dependency. Person, Organization, AgentInRole, and Identifier are not redeclared here; they are cross-profile links to CDIFCore. Instrument is a local class because it carries provenance-specific attribute shape.
class.definition: An activity that generated the described resource. Combines prov:Activity (temporal bounds, used/wasAssociatedWith semantics) with schema:Action (instruments, methodology, agents in named roles, action chaining). Supports linking earlier activities to later ones via schema:object back-references to prior schema:result @ids.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - identifier for this activity, used as target of schema:object back-references when chaining activities.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable name for the activity.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - text description of what the activity did.

attribute.name: actionStatus
attribute.definition: schema:actionStatus - status of the activity (CompletedActionStatus, ActiveActionStatus, etc.). A schema.org ActionStatusType enumeration value (URI string).

attribute.name: startTime
attribute.definition: schema:startTime / prov:startedAtTime - when the activity began.

attribute.name: endTime
attribute.definition: schema:endTime / prov:endedAtTime - when the activity ended.

attribute.name: location
attribute.definition: schema:location - location where the activity took place (string, geo:Place URI, or PostalAddress; modeled as string here, dereference via @id).

attribute.name: actionProcess
attribute.definition: schema:actionProcess - reference to a HowTo / methodology resource (URI string).

attribute.name: error
attribute.definition: schema:error - description of any error or failure mode in the activity.

class._comment: Instrument - the software/instrument/tool used by a provenance activity (inline under prov:used items via the schema:instrument sub-key). Records identifier, label, descriptive metadata, and optional propertyID/value attributes that describe the instrument configuration.
class.definition: An instrument or tool used by a provenance activity. Typically a software package or piece of equipment; recorded inline under prov:used items via the schema:instrument sub-key. Carries identifier, label, optional version, and free-form descriptive properties.

attribute.name: version
attribute.definition: schema:softwareVersion / schema:version - version identifier of the instrument or software.

association._comment: Dataset -> ProvActivity via prov:wasGeneratedBy. The Dataset (defined in CDIFCore) carries this association; cross-profile linkage via the registry. Composition: activities are documentation of how the Dataset came to be.
association.definition: prov:wasGeneratedBy - the provenance activities that generated this Dataset. Array; order is not significant but action chaining may be encoded via schema:object back-references on later activities.

association._comment: ProvActivity -> Instrument via prov:used + schema:instrument. The prov:used item is an object with a schema:instrument sub-key; the diagram collapses this to a direct ProvActivity_uses_Instrument association.
association.definition: prov:used (with schema:instrument sub-key on the use item) - instruments or tools used by this activity.

association._comment: ProvActivity -> Person via schema:agent. Person is defined in CDIFCore (cross-profile link). schema:agent is the primary responsible agent; maps to prov:wasAssociatedWith.
association.definition: schema:agent - primary responsible agent (Person). May alternatively be Organization or AgentInRole (CDIFCore). Maps to prov:wasAssociatedWith semantics.

association._comment: ProvActivity -> Organization via schema:agent (alternative to Person).
association.definition: schema:agent - primary responsible agent (Organization). Alternative to Person.

association._comment: ProvActivity -> Person via schema:participant (additional participants beyond the primary agent).
association.definition: schema:participant - additional participants in the activity beyond the primary schema:agent.
